verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a CLI security tool like Gitleaks, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The items cover only scanning commands, configuration, baselines, and the GitHub Action, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
